scope: Corollary 10.3 (Zero-temperature variational limit) of the manuscript “The Mézard–Parisi formula for diluted spin glasses” (preprints/The-Mezard-Parisi-formula-for-diluted-spin-glasses-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 221 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f415bacf0f91bf5a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 35. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each model in Corollaries 10.1 and 10.2, the limit g = lim N→∞ 1 N E max σ EN (σ) exists and satisfies g = lim β→∞ 1 β inf r≥0 inf ζ,m Br,β(ζ, m). (10.1) More precisely, the expression inside the temperature limit lies in [g, g+log(2)/β]. For unit-weight SAT, the limiting expected minimum number of violated clauses per variable is −g.
